question: What are the actual fixed-population cold GAE and native counts of the repository rho implementations, relative to the standard-negating sqrt(pi/4) reference, with all outcomes retained?

claims.text: Exact finite correctness, counted costs, determinism and replay for the frozen population; report per-curve totals and ratios descriptively.
sqrt(pi/4) is the standard-negating average reference, not an exact finite-population value or universal lower bound.
No asymptotic rejection/confirmation, mathematical optimality, isolated negation-map causal effect, wall-time speedup, compiler refinement or independent-host proof.

hypotheses.statement: On a 20-bit prime-order curve BSGS with the negation map pays its table setup in counted operations and lands above rho.negation in S.
hypotheses.mechanism: BSGS charges sqrt(r)-scale table construction before the first lookup; rho's expected cost is sqrt(pi r / 4) with the negation map.

predictions.minimum_effect: median S of bsgs-neg above the upper end of the rho A/A interval

data_seen.measured: the same session's verified counts; this example is in-sample by construction

factors.name: inputs
factors.how: Four existing generic prime_roster curves at14/16/18/20 bits, alltargets derived from frozen spec; independent of arm.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One exact release binary/source/compiler, no code tuning; hash pinned before data.

factors.how: Frozen ecbench SHA256 derivation per workload/round, shared across arms; disjoint pilot/main master seeds.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: Existing alternate harness order within rounds.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record CPU/OS/kernel/SMT/NUMA/affinity/PSI/co-tenants; L0 counts only, no valid scientific clocks.

factors.name: layout_environment
factors.how: Each run fresh child process; binary and single-thread environment fixed, host capsule retained.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Unmasked descriptive analysis script frozen before data, all cells/failures included; no discretionary rank/significance claim.

comparisons.threshold: All planned rows verified; all measured deterministic replay counts identical; each same-seed A/A measured pair count identical. Otherwise not_validated; no survivor-only conclusion.
Per paired-workload/round count equality; tests determinism only, not independent-seed variability.

seed_derivation.note: ecbench spec spec.json: uniform_scalar_sha256_v1 target law; derive_u64 ecbench.algorithm_seed(workload,round,measurement.seed), paired across all arms. Pilot/master seeds20261112001/20261112002; main20261112011/20261112012.

instance_sampling.rule: 64 fixed targets across four roster curves by spec, no outcome-dependent selection

blinding.how: Exact/descriptive all-cell audit, no selection/inferential verdict. Native fixed analysis frozen before data; method parameters necessarily public.

power.note: No hypothesis test/power claim. Fixed finite descriptive coverage and exact answers/replay; alpha unused schema metadata. Main16 targets per curve, three independent algorithm rounds; not sufficient to establish limiting constant.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Separate frozen preflight sessionECBS1h9cd21a0011c9:12calls, start/end interval109ms. L0 interval used only for prospective budget planning, not a scientific speed measurement. Conservative18s whole-main estimate; hard180s session cap and15s child cap unchanged.

primary.name: Total cold counted cost
primary.definition: All native method phases, jump-table/setup, starts, walks, cycle handling and internal verification; add/double1; scalar actual add/double events.

primary.name: Normalized cold count
primary.definition: Total cold count divided by actual subgroup-order square root; report ratio to sqrt(pi/4) birthday reference, not an optimality floor.

execution.queue: approved zero-paid local checkpoint; no EKS/cloud jobs

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed64workloads x3arms x(3measured+1warmup)=768calls then stop;15s perchild; no outcome-dependent retry.
Global session cap180seconds with SIGINT then5s kill grace; preserve any incomplete session. No paid execution.
Main begins only if all12pilot calls verify and measured replays match; otherwise main is not_validated.

invalidation_rules: Any failure, timeout, interruption, wrong answer or missing row prevents complete-population claim; retain all rows and native comparison bound flags.
All clocks scientifically invalid; L0 operation counts remain counted, not timing evidence.
Missing unpriced counts prevents ranking; no ranking unless stable at0/0.1/1GAE per operation.

decision_rule.text: known_answer_pass only when all planned answers, exact replay and paired A/A count checks pass. Report every curve/arm meanS, ratios and native phase/unpriced counts. A finite mismatch with0.886 is not a refutation of the qualified asymptotic statement. Native SQL checks every same-seed A/A pair, phase event/native counter and recovered answer, including retained warmups. Native count-integrity row must report0noninteger/oversized costs. Synthetic one-counter corruption must be detected before main.
decision_rule.threshold: All planned answers and deterministic measured replays identical; no statistical threshold.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-curve meanS and native ratios of paired sums; all-arm pricing band at0/0.1/1.
decision_rule.interval: Exact finite counts; native descriptive cluster/delta and bootstrap intervals retained without asymptotic verdict.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: MeanS/sqrt(pi/4) and same-population configured-method ratio; no isolated negation-map causal claim.

graphs: Per-curve totalS and standard-negation birthday reference; every native phase/unpriced counter visible.

inadmissible: Dropping failed/censored/warmup records from retained evidence.
Calling sqrt(pi/4) a universal rigorous lower bound.
Claiming asymptotic confirmation/refutation from this small population.
Reading same-seed A/A as independent noise variance.
Calling local replay independent-host validation or a Lean compiler/runtime refinement.
Wall-time speed claims or paid/cloud execution.

literature.claim: Selected primary SafeCurves survey assumptions/cost model; primary URLs/access/read scopes explicit.
Native actual prime-curve rho, total counted costs, seed pairing, registered curves, and descriptive interval implementation.

extensions.scope: Count-only approved local checkpoint; actual wall intervals are retained but invalid scientific clocks.

Authoritative compiled source baseline and every selected Rust/path-dependency/compile-time JSON input are pinned here; binary and threads are pinned in every arm. Actual runtime Git commit is retained in sessions/exports.
